question: With reference to the Centre of Excellence on Human-Wildlife Conflict and the National Human-Wildlife Conflict Portal, consider the following statements: 1. The Centre of Excellence was inaugurated at WII-SACON, Coimbatore. 2. The portal is intended to support data management, knowledge sharing and decision support for conflict mitigation. 3. The first edition of Current Status of Human-Wildlife Conflict in India: An Overview was released alongside the initiative. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: The MoEFCC release states all three: CoE at WII-SACON, a conflict portal for data/knowledge/decision support, and release of the overview publication.
subject: Environment

question: With reference to the Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS), consider the following statements: 1. It is an RBI-regulated electronic platform for financing and discounting MSME trade receivables. 2. The new mandate requires all operating CPSEs to route settlement of MSME invoices through RBI-authorised TReDS platforms. 3. TReDS financing is intended to give MSME suppliers collateral-free access to working capital against approved invoices. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: TReDS is RBI-regulated, the CPSE mandate applies to MSME invoice settlement, and the platform enables collateral-free invoice discounting.
subject: Economy

question: The July 2026 amendment to the Drugs Rules, 1945 relating to high alcohol-containing formulations provides that:
options: (a) all formulations containing any ethyl alcohol are banned from sale in India.
(b) formulations with more than 12% v/v ethyl alcohol in quantities exceeding 30 mL are removed from Schedule K exemption and brought under Schedule H1.
(c) alcohol-containing medicinal formulations are shifted from the Drugs and Cosmetics Act to the Food Safety and Standards Act.
(d) only imported high alcohol-containing formulations require prescription-based sale.
explanation: The amendment removes Schedule K exemption for formulations with more than 12% v/v ethyl alcohol in quantities above 30 mL and places them under Schedule H1.
subject: Polity & Governance
